Services

Pups and cats, all sizes welcome

Dog grooming

Fluffy poodles, scruffy schnauzers, floofy shepherds. Every groom is tailored to the actual dog in front of her.

  • Bath & brushfrom $55
  • Full groom, small under 20 lbs$85–$95
  • Full groom, medium 20–50 lbs$105–$120
  • Full groom, large 50–80 lbs$135–$160
  • Full groom, XL 80+ lbs$165+

Cat grooming

Yes, cats too! Same one-on-one patience, zero trips to a loud shop.

  • Bath & brush$90–$110
  • Lion cut$125–$175

Add-ons

  • Nail trim$15–$20
  • Flea bath$25
  • De-matting per 15 minutes$15–$20

Prices vary with size, coat and condition. Full grooms include a bath and haircut. Annee accepts cash, card, Venmo, or Zelle.

What to have ready

Annee brings everything she needs. You just provide a space to groom, access to water, and an outlet.
